meta.title: Lightweight Wallpaper
meta.description: Set the Harness window wallpaper from Bing daily images, Wikimedia Commons art or Cleveland Museum CC0 works — or upload your own. The art tab ships 8 painter and movement presets on a single row with paging, thumbnails and result lists are cached locally, up to 20 local wallpapers (downloaded or uploaded) can be re-applied in one click, cache usage can be inspected and cleared, and fill, window scrim, dim and blur are adjustable, with adjustable glass for the composer card and the New session button plus a one-switch light-mode text contrast boost.
